content: Job-ad range honesty: no existing product found that scores a salary range for honesty. Commentary notes a wide range like 80k-180k technically complies while signalling the company is hiding the number. Poland: the Dec 2025 recruitment provisions apply only to prospective employees, NOT to B2B or civil-law contracts (umowa zlecenia / o dzielo), which makes employment-type detection a legally meaningful signal in PL.
